user.title: Add a BrightSign player
user.description: Enter the player's IP address. The DWS password is optional.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the BrightSign player.
data_description.password: Optional. Leave empty if the player has no password or you don't know it: the player is then added with basic entities (online, sync) and you can add the password later with Reconfigure. The user is always "admin"; the factory default password is the player's serial number. Left empty, the integration first tries the player's serial number (the factory default password) automatically.

discovery_confirm.title: BrightSign player found
discovery_confirm.description: A BrightSign player was found at {host}. The DWS password is optional: leave it empty to add the player with basic entities.

data_description.password: Optional. Leave empty if the player has no password or you don't know it: the player is then added with basic entities (online, sync) and you can add the password later with Reconfigure. Left empty, the integration first tries the player's serial number (the factory default password) automatically.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure BrightSign player
reconfigure.description: Change the address, or add or change the DWS password to unlock model, uptime, HDMI status, reboot and CEC control.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the BrightSign player.
data_description.password: Leave empty to use the player without the DWS REST API. Left empty, the integration first tries the player's serial number (the factory default password) automatically.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter the DWS password
reauth_confirm.description: The BrightSign player at {host} rejected the stored DWS password, or its HTTPS certificate changed (firmware update or factory reset). Enter the password to continue; the current certificate is then trusted. Leave it empty to continue with basic entities only.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the player. Check the IP address and that the player is on.
error.invalid_auth: The player rejected this DWS password. Correct it, or leave the field empty to add the player with basic entities.

send_udp.name: Send UDP command
send_udp.description: Sends a UDP message, e.g. to trigger a UDP input event in a BrightAuthor presentation.

host.name: Host
host.description: IP address of the player, or a broadcast address such as 255.255.255.255.

port.name: Port
port.description: UDP receiver port of the presentation (default 5000).

message.name: Message
message.description: The UDP command text as defined in the presentation.
